product_overview: AETHERIS is an AI-native employee verification ecosystem that helps candidates maintain cryptographically verifiable career records while enabling recruiters to instantly verify experience, skills, and fit. It replaces slow, manual background checks with role-based dashboards, real-time verification workflows, and candidate-to-job matching.
core_goals: Provide a secure, role-based platform for employees, recruiters, and administrators
Enable cryptographically backed verification of employment history and skills
Support job discovery, matching, and application workflows for candidates
Allow recruiters to create, manage, and verify job-related requests efficiently
Deliver a polished, responsive user experience with theme-aware navigation and dashboards

features.name: Landing Page & Navigation
features.description: Public-facing entry point with product messaging, feature highlights, and navigation controls including theme toggle.
user_flows: GET / to load the landing page -> Receive 200 with hero content, feature highlights, and navigation -> Toggle theme in the UI -> Receive updated client-side styling state
GET / to load the landing page -> Receive 200 with public marketing content -> Request a non-existent page -> Receive 404 or routed fallback for unsupported navigation

features.name: Authentication & Authorization
features.description: Employee and recruiter account access with login, registration, and role-based access control across dashboards.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid employee or recruiter details -> Receive 201 with created account or auth session -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT or session token -> GET /api/profile with token -> Receive 200 with authorized user profile
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /api/profile without token -> Receive 401 or 403 access denied

features.name: Employee Profile & Credentials
features.description: Employee dashboard for managing personal details, verified work experiences, skills, and certifications used for verification and matching.
user_flows: GET /api/profile with valid employee token -> Receive 200 with personal details, experiences, skills, and certifications -> PATCH /api/profile with updated profile data -> Receive 200 with saved profile -> GET /api/profile again -> Receive 200 with updated credentials
GET /api/profile without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> PATCH /api/profile with invalid or malformed profile payload -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Job Discovery & Application
features.description: Job board experience for browsing, searching, filtering, matching, and submitting job applications based on verified candidate data.
user_flows: GET /api/jobs to fetch available job listings -> Receive 200 with job board results -> GET /api/jobs?search=engineer&filter=verified to narrow listings -> Receive 200 with matched jobs -> POST /api/jobs/apply with selected job and candidate token -> Receive 201 with application confirmation
GET /api/jobs with unsupported filter parameters -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/jobs/apply without a valid jobId or token -> Receive 401 unauthorized or 400 bad request

features.name: Recruiter Job Posting
features.description: Recruiter tools for creating, updating, and managing job postings as well as initiating candidate verification requests.
user_flows: POST /api/recruiter/jobs with valid recruiter token and job details -> Receive 201 with created posting -> PUT /api/recruiter/jobs/{jobId} with edits -> Receive 200 with updated job -> GET /api/recruiter/jobs to review managed postings -> Receive 200 with recruiter job list
POST /api/recruiter/jobs without recruiter authorization -> Receive 403 forbidden -> PUT /api/recruiter/jobs/{jobId} with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Verification Workflows
features.description: Cryptographic proof-of-employment and skill verification flows that create, track, and update trusted verification records in real time.
user_flows: POST /employee/verification with employeeId, type, status, and timestamp -> Receive 201 with pending verification request -> GET /employee/verification/{verificationId} -> Receive 200 with verification status and cryptographic proof details -> PATCH /employee/verification/{verificationId} with reviewer update -> Receive 200 with updated verification outcome
POST /employee/verification with invalid employeeId or unsupported type -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /employee/verification/{verificationId} for unknown record -> Receive 404 not found

tech_stack.frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Zustand
tech_stack.backend: Express, Node.js, Prisma ORM, MongoDB Atlas, Supabase Auth
